title: Japan 30-Year JGB auction (¥600bn anticipated, first reopening of issue 92) — the same morning the BoJ publishes the Outlook meeting's Summary of Opinions, and the same date as US CPI
source: EST: mof.go.jp English November 2026 auction calendar (english/policy/jgbs/auction/calendar/2611e.htm), re-fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 25,188 bytes) for this initial research; its table row reads 'Nov. 10, 2026 | 30-year'. The DATE is MOF's own. NO SIZE IS ASSERTED: no November row carries an 'Auction Announcement' href on 2026-09-09, MOF's note on the page reads 'Each issue amount will be announced about one week prior to each auction date' (terms due ~2026-11-03), and the December calendar 2612e.htm still 404s. ¥600bn is the anticipated base case from MOF's own announcement pages, which read 'About 600 billion yen' for the 2026-04-07, 07-07, 08-06 and 09-03 auctions (auct20260331e / auct20260630e / auct20260730e / auct20260827e, all HTTP 200, fetched 2026-09-09), and from the Auction Results for JGBs workbook (english/policy/jgbs/auction/past_auction_results/Auction_Results_for_JGBs.xls, 492,032 bytes, last saved 2026-08-13, parsed 2026-09-09), which shows ¥900bn from 2024-01-12, ¥800bn from 2025-04-08, ¥700bn from 2025-07-03 and ¥600bn from 2026-04-07. THE ISSUE IDENTITY IS DERIVED FROM A MOF-STATED RULE, NOT FROM A MOF STATEMENT ABOUT THIS AUCTION: MOF's announcement pages carry a verbatim reopening footnote ('30-year JGBs to be issued in August/September will be a reopening issue of the July 2026 issue') and carry NO such footnote in a quarter-opening month (2026-04-07 and 2026-07-07 have none), and across the workbook the 33 issues 59-91 (2018-04 -> 2026-07) each open in Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct, run EXACTLY three auctions, mature on the 20th of Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec and step +3 months per issue in 32 of 32 steps. Issue 91 has now had its three (07-07, 08-06, 09-03), so 2026-10-08 opens issue 92 and 2026-11-10 is its first reopening. Filed `estimate` on the two counts every JGB entry on this calendar records: the size is anticipated rather than announced, and market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: Proposed twice on 2026-09-09 — by the jgb-20y-auction-2026-11-18 sweep (as this pair's control leg) and by the jgb-40y-auction-2026-11-25 sweep (as 'the first month on this calendar to carry all three super-long tenors inside fifteen days') — both proposals read as input and now shadowed by this canonical file; researched the same day (docs/research/events/jgb-30y-auction-2026-11-10.md). BOTH STATED RATIONALES FAIL, AND THE SECOND FAILS ON ITS OWN PREMISE. Across the workbook, 75 calendar months have carried all three super-long tenors; 35 of them span 15 days or fewer and 26 span STRICTLY FEWER than November 2026's 15, median span 18 days, tightest 12 (2020-05, 2024-05, 2025-01) — November 2026 is the 35th percentile of tightness, with the same configuration as recently as 2026-07, 2026-05, 2025-11, 2025-05, 2025-01 and 2024-11. The 8-day gap to the 11-18 20-year is the calendar's MODAL rhythm (median 8 days to the next super-long auction, 54% within 8, a 7-day gap 85 times). And the congestion effect the premise implied is a null: corr(days to next super-long, tail) -0.050 (t = -0.70), corr with cover -0.042 (t = -0.59), nothing on the trailing side either. The DiD control-leg rationale was already retired by jgb-20y-auction-2026-11-18's power arithmetic (one more month-matched pair moves the minimum detectable effect 1.50bp -> 1.47bp against a permanent 0.81bp floor) and is not re-run here. WHAT THE DATE ACTUALLY IS: the most contaminated one this family has drawn, on both sides of the Pacific. Five other tracked events share 2026-11-10 — cpi-2026-11-10 (high, CONFIRMED), us-china-tariff-truce-expiry-2026-11-10 (high), treasury-10y-note-2026-11-10, eia-steo-2026-11-10, and boj-summary-of-opinions-2026-11-10, the Summary of Opinions of the October 29-30 Outlook MPM, released 08:50 JST on this calendar's own BoJ primary, roughly 3h45m before the auction result. So the jgb-30y-auction-2026-10-08 ledger's already-refuted same-date JGB->US spillover test is not merely refuted on 11-10, it is UNRUNNABLE: the US 30Y CMT close-to-close move is jointly determined by a confirmed CPI print and a same-day 10-year auction (2026 daily sd 3.75bp, 14.6% of sessions already move >= 5bp), and the JGB side is not clean either. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is `low` for the reasons every sibling JGB ledger records: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure and no house playbook is rates-keyed. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
